effectiveExcludedKeywords: Adding agentId validation, caller-identity checks, session binding, or dispatch-evidence cross-checks to init_check_set
Changes to the draft-check or delivery-check signature domains, which have the same shape but are separate artifacts
Changing the REQUIRED_INIT_CHECK_AGENTS set or the number of required reviewers

Changing whether one caller can invoke init_check_set twice with different registered agentIds to satisfy both required reviewers. This is BY DESIGN per EXP-001 and is positively asserted by four smoke tests; closing it would remove load-bearing behaviour and is explicitly not this story's job

Re-signing the existing corpus by routing it through the handler. Roughly 195 of 637 files carry an actor absent from AGENT_DISPATCH_REGISTRY and would throw agent_dispatch_actor_unknown, so this is not implementable and any design assuming it must be rejected
